messages:
Kate O'Neill: Hi team  coordinating onsite for candidate Jordan H. on Tue July 22. Requested window 10:00am 2:00pm PT. Needs wheelchair access, quiet room between interviews, and a loaner Windows laptop (corporate image) for a live coding task. Also asked if we require COVID vaccination proof or if a negative PCR within 72h is acceptable.

Priya Singh: I can take the 11:00 11:45 design panel. Happy to help with scheduling.

IT Support: We have loaner Win-201 (tag W-589) available tentatively. Need 24h lead to image with corp image img-corp-2025. Who will pickup?

Kate O'Neill: Prefer Ops to sign it out. Can Facilities hold the loaner at concierge for pickup? Also candidate prefers an early lunch (12:15) and gluten-free option.

Facilities: We can reserve Quiet Room C (2nd floor) and post a "Do Not Disturb" sign. Concierge can hold package and loaner with signed checkout.

People Ops Bot: Badge request created  BR-12487. Expected ready 12h before visit. COVID accommodation note: site policy allows negative PCR within 72h or valid vaccine card; please redact health docs per HR policy.

Kate O'Neill: Note for calendar: 10:00 10:30 intro with hiring manager; 10:45 11:30 systems design; 12:15 lunch; 1:15 2:00 coding exercise (using loaner). Zoom fallback link included. Onsite address: Building B, 7th floor, Room 704.

Priya Singh: I added the lunch note and panel names. Also: candidate requested a longer break after design because they use assistive software. Please confirm Quiet Room availability.

Facilities: Quiet Room C confirmed with adjustable lighting and noise-dampening screens. We'll provide an external keyboard and an ergonomic mouse on request.

IT Support: Imaging scheduled Mon 6pm. Loaner tag W-589 will be preloaded with exam env:
```
- image: img-corp-2025
- exam script: C:\\hiring\\setup_exam.bat
- guest account: hire-temp\\candidate
```

Kate O'Neill: Reimbursements: candidate requested travel prepay vs expense. Policy: we can issue a prepaid corporate travel card for candidates up to $300 for local travel. If you prefer prepaid, send candidate email to ops-travel@redwood.com.

Priya Singh: Jordan asked about background check timing and whether results delay offers. HR timeline?

People Ops Bot: Background check policy: contingent offer pending background check results. Typical turnaround 24 business days for domestic checks. For international checks, allow up to 10 business days.

Kate O'Neill: Action items recap: (1) IT image loaner W-589 and drop at concierge (2) Facilities prepare Quiet Room C and accessibility kit (3) People Ops issue badge and travel card if candidate opts (4) Kate to inform candidate about PCR/vaccine options and receipts flow. Please react with :white_check_mark: when done.

IT Support: :white_check_mark: Loaner will be at concierge by 6:30pm Mon.

Facilities: :white_check_mark: Quiet Room C setup confirmed.

People Ops Bot: Reminder created for loaner pickup and badge pickup on Mon 6:00pm.
